entities.text: Karaggi Vishwanadham vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: A.Rajasheker Reddy
Bench: A.Rajasheker Reddy, M.Laxman
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice A.Rajasheker Reddy
 And
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Laxman
 Writ Petition No.23838 of 2021
Order:

(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice A.Rajasheker Reddy) Sri Karaggi Vishwanadham, S/o. Karaggi Nagaraju filed this Habeas Corpus petition seeking a direction to 2nd respondent to produce Sri Kinjarapu Dilleshwar Rao - the Detenu, and to declare the detention order vide proceedings No.75/PD-CELL/CYB/2021, dated 04.06.2021, passed by the 2nd respondent, whereby, the detenu was detained under Section 3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot-leggers, Dacoits, Drugs- Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers,
Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders,
Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders,
Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986) (as amended in Act 13 of 2018), as illegal and arbitrary.

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot-leggers, Dacoits, Drugs- Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that the co-accused/A5, against whom detention orders were passed basing on the self same crime has been quashed by order dated 04.10.2021 in W.P.No.14372 of 2021, and the present detenu/A4 stands on the same footing to that of the other co-accused and is entitled for the same relief which is granted by this Court in the aforesaid writ petition.
3. Heard Sri Pasham Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner, and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for learned Additional Advocate General, who does not dispute the same.
4. In view of the same and for the reasons alike in W.P.No.14372 of 2021, dated 04.10.2021, the writ petition is allowed, and the order of detention vide proceedings No.75/PD- CELL/CYB/2021 dated 04.06.2021 passed by the 2nd respondent - Commissioner of Police, Cyberabad Commissionerate, and the consequential confirmation order vide G.O.Rt.No.1813, General Administration (Spl. (Law and Order) Department, dated 16.08.2021,
passed by the 1st respondent - Principal Secretary to Government, General Administration (Spl.
Karaggi Vishwanadham vs The State Of Telangana on 3 January, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116845218/
1 (Law and Order) Department, Government of Telangana, are hereby set aside, and the detenu - Kinjarapu Dilleshwar Rao, S/o. Jagannayakulu shall be set at liberty forthwith, if he is not required in any other criminal case.
5. Office is to append a copy of the order dated 04.10.2021 in W.P.No.14372 of 2021 to this order.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
